First, note: 05-07-1959 means 5 July 1959.  
277 days before:  
1959 is not a leap year (1959 not divisible by 4).  

From 5 July 1959:  
Back to 5 Jan 1959 = 181 days (Jan 31 + Feb 28 + Mar 31 + Apr 30 + May 31 + Jun 30 + 5 days of July? Wait, that's forward; let's do backward properly).  

Better:  
Count back from 5 July 1959:  
June: 30 days → back to 5 June (30 days earlier)  
May: 31 days → back to 5 May (61 days earlier)  
April: 30 days → back to 5 April (91 days earlier)  
March: 31 days → back to 5 March (122 days earlier)  
February: 28 days → back to 5 February (150 days earlier)  
January: 31 days → back to 5 January (181 days earlier).  

We need 277 days earlier, so 277 − 181 = 96 days before 5 Jan 1959.  

Go back from 5 Jan 1959 into 1958:  
December 1958: 31 days → back to 5 Dec 1958 (31 days earlier)  
November: 30 days → back to 5 Nov 1958 (61 days earlier)  
October: 31 days → back to 5 Oct 1958 (92 days earlier) → need 96 days earlier, so 4 more days before 5 Oct 1958.  

4 days before 5 Oct 1958 = 1 Oct 1958.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1958-10-01
